navaid.name: Epava Evangelia
navaid.description: MV E Evangelia is a shipwrecked refrigerated cargo ship. She was built in Northern Ireland in 1942 as the Empire ship Empire Strength, was operated by Blue Star Line from 1942 to 1961, was bought by Greek shipowners in 1965 and wrecked in 1968.
